title: Fact ledger entry
description: One checkable fact. research/facts/<topic>.json is a JSON array of these. Only verified facts or labeled demo facts render as figures.

id.description: Dotted, lowercase, region-scoped; first segment is the pack id.

claim.description: Plain sentence stating the fact (research-facing, not displayed).

value.description: The value in the form the server ledger loader types directly (server/src/myad_server/ledger.py coerce_value). null for kind:lookup, for unsourced facts with no value, and never a sentinel for 'none recorded' (that is an outcome; see demo-outcomes.json). By value_type: text = string plus value_language (BCP-47, e.g. 'en'); code = string, never translated; codes = JSON array of strings; phone = digits with optional separators, no extension (put it in `extension`); date = 'YYYY-MM-DD'; money = decimal string or number with unit an ISO 4217 code ('USD'), any period or qualifier in unit_detail; quantity = decimal string or number with unit; weekdays = comma-separated lowercase English weekday names or a JSON array; place = typed object {type:'place', place:{name, coordinate:{latitude, longitude}, address?, language?}}; flag = JSON boolean. A typed FactValue object ({type: ...}) is accepted for any value_type.

unit.description: Unit. For money exactly an ISO 4217 code ('USD'); put the period or qualifier ('per month, gross rent limit') in unit_detail. For quantity a unit string ('days', 'year'). null when not applicable.

source_id.description: id in research/sources.yaml. Empty string only when status is unsourced or demo with no retrievable source.

url.description: Exact URL the quote was taken from; null only when unsourced or demo without a source.

quote.description: Exact text copied from the source, whitespace-normalized; ' ... ' marks an elision between exact segments. Never paraphrased. For lookup facts: a short snippet of a live sample response.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset: when the source was read (for unsourced: when the search was done).

check_every.description: ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P7D, P30D, P90D, P1Y.

value_type.description: One of the ten ADCore FactValue cases (ARCHITECTURE.md 13.z). Required when kind is lookup. quantity requires unit.

kind.description: static (default) or lookup (address-dependent; value null; resolved at a pin by the lookup block).

desk.description: Desk id (pack-scoped, lowercase) the card hands off to. Desk contact facts are <desk-id>.name/.phone/.url/.address/.hours/.languages.

correction_note.description: Present when the source disagrees with the plan.

notes.description: Research notes: what was searched, caveats.

secondary.description: true when the source is not official (source official:false).

topics.description: Optional intent tags for retrieval. Every tag must be an id in research/topics.yaml (validate.py enforces).

unit_detail.description: Money only: the period or qualifier that used to live in unit, e.g. 'USD/month (gross rent limit)'.

value_language.description: BCP-47 language of a text value. Required when value_type is text and value is a string.

extension.description: Phone only: extension dialed after the number.

x-address-text.description: Desk address as written by the source, kept when value is a typed place.

coordinate_source.description: How a place value's coordinate was obtained (geocoder, candidate type, score, query, date).

x-flag-value.description: Original yes/no value when Content asked for the fact as text.
